title: Tag
summary: A neutral label that can carry a remove button.

props.name: value
props.description: Sent in the remove event (the identifier, not state); defaults to the text.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dim the tag and disable the button.

props.name: controlled
props.description: The host removes the tag: a press only raises pk-remove and never removes the element (the host renders the list, so it removes the tag from its own state). Used by the Blazor wrapper.

events.name: pk-remove
events.description: The remove button was pressed. preventDefault keeps the tag; when nobody cancels it and controlled is off, the tag removes itself after the event. With controlled the host removes it.

a11y: The remove control is a real button named "Remove <label>"; it is 44px on a phone.
